title: Demonstration Grant for Carbon Capture and Utilization Catalysis
description: Supports early-career investigators developing catalytic and electrochemical routes that convert captured CO2 into fuels and chemicals. A letter of intent is required before the full proposal.
eligibility_text: Open to universities and nonprofit research institutions in the United States.
applicant_types: Public and state institutions of higher education

title: Rural Public Health Innovation Awards
description: Funds community-based projects that improve rural public health outcomes and health equity. Limited to one application per institution.
